chunks: And ʿAbdullāh ibn Jabalah narrated from Samāʿah, from Abū Baṣīr, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I said to him: A man who has children—does it lie within his right to assign his wealth to his relatives? He said: “It is his wealth; he may dispose of it as he wishes until death comes to him.”

key_terms.ٱلْمَوْتُ: death, marking the end of his lifetime control over wealth

ai.seo_question: Can a man give his wealth to relatives during his lifetime even if he has children?
ai.summary: This hadith states that a person retains authority over his wealth during his lifetime, even if he has children. He may allocate it to his relatives as he wishes up until the approach of death.
